signal: D-Tools showcased SI v24 and new AI-powered D-Tools Cloud tools at InfoComm 2026, including multi-user editing, a Mobile Install App, and Inventory Asset Management

email.body1:
Shenelle, saw D-Tools showed off SI v24 and a wave of AI-powered Cloud features at InfoComm, from multi-user editing to Inventory Asset Management.

A release cycle like that usually opens more in-market integrators than the team can work, and reps end up buried in research instead of conversations. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for D-Tools Cloud off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Shenelle, quick follow-up for D-Tools.

With fresh Cloud features in market, most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to cover the integrator base. The gap shows up late, and by then the quarter is a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings D-Tools Cloud needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Shenelle, last bit of proof for D-Tools.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how D-Tools Cloud's reply rate likely compares to other vertical SaaS vendors. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Shenelle, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A post-InfoComm push keeps a sales team plenty busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to D-Tools either way.
